pages.title: Place of the dead souls
pages.text: It is extremely hard to make anything out through the fog.

pages.title: What is here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:mist/fern)Fern$(/l): glows and yields a Pearl;$(li)$(l:mist/potercha)Potercha$(/l): a ghostly guide;$(li)$(l:mist/souls)Souls$(/l): animals and ordinary foes.$(br2)Even when nothing can be seen, the feeling of being watched does not leave you.
